depth_justification: The copilot references real specifics of ImpfPlan (BAG calendar, manual yearly update, offline behaviour, parent email/child birth date, Swiss age of consent) and cites concrete articles (GDPR Art. 8, nFADP Art. 5(c), ePrivacy Art. 5(3), Guidelines 2/2023), but it repeats questions verbatim and repeatedly mislabels a deterministic calendar-lookup app as a 'high-risk AI system' under the EU AI Act, showing pattern-matching over genuine reasoning about this app's actual mechanism.
actionability_justification: Mitigations are mostly directional rather than implementable recipes ('Conduct a DPIA', 'implement granular consent for SDKs', 'Introduce automated update mechanisms', 'Conduct offline testing', 'Define a clear data retention policy'); they name relevant articles and RAG citations but give no concrete UI/implementation steps a developer could ship tomorrow.
